name: guide-chapters-tab
description: The guide book's small-screen Chapters tab (#192) at the runner's 854x480 window and GUI scale 2, where the 248 px book is taller than the 240 px screen: idle, hovered, and the overlay it opens. Clicks by position only, so it runs under -Lang.

steps.label: park the cursor off the tab

steps.name: tab-idle
steps.look: the Chapters tab at the top of the right page shows its whole label, no letter cut by the screen edge or the tab's lower edge

steps.name: tab-hover
steps.look: hovered, the tab grows and the whole label is still readable

steps.label: pick a chapter from the overlay
open an entry on that spread (a titled page)
park the cursor off the tab

steps.name: tab-over-title
steps.look: on a titled page the tab stops above the page title

steps.name: tab-over-title-hover
steps.look: hovered, the tab grows two rows; the label stays whole
